description: Camera clips shown in 'Now in the cell', one per process step. Files live in public/videos/<process>/. Video: MP4 (H.264), 720p, 5-15 s, NO sound, under ~5 MB. Poster: a still image shown while loading and when the cell is stopped. An entry with only a poster shows a still (used for operator steps). Steps without an entry show no camera panel. Keep clips neutral: never show the anomaly before the alarm. Source: COROB demonstrator videos (R&D centre consent given); no people, captions or overlays in the cuts.
